Bill.BriefDescription: Imposing a distance requirement for gathering signatures on an initiative measure or referendum.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to gathering signatures for an initiative orreferendum at stand alone stores and retail stores that are located incommercial retail complexes; and adding a new section to chapter 29A.72RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 29A.72 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: Any person who is gathering signatures for an initiative measure orreferendum filed with the secretary of state is prohibited within apresumptively reasonable minimum distance of twentyfive feet fromentrances, exits, and windows that serve stand alone stores or retailstores that are located in commercial retail complexes.
